_doc: Words with a numeral or a digit that write a fixed term, a unit or a band, never a number (next_flow::number_free, next_tree::number_free). terms: names and fixed phrases, blanked unless a numeral, a quantity word or a placeholder comes right before; si_units: units whose prefix is part of the unit, blanked after a placeholder too (a value's unit), never after a numeral or a quantity word; rate_before + a run of powers: a rate's base (每千人, 每十万人), not a count (每三人 stays a number); scale_open + a run of powers + a scale_units word: a unit label in brackets (（百万吨）); a run + one of age_after, or a run + one of age_between + a run + age_unit: an age band (五岁以下, 15至24岁, 65岁及以上). A count of places (四国) is not here: it is checked against the places the page draws.
